hypothesis: The coarse current-pitch oracle has goal-scale headroom, while previous deployable tests either trained outcome experts only on sparse TrackMan matches or applied dense labels through a hand-built linear correction. Training full exact-C CatBoost outcome experts on the nearly complete counter-reconstructed pitch groups may let soft marginalization exploit uncertain group probabilities without requiring top-1 selector accuracy.

relationship_to_prior_work.V5_PITCHTYPE_MOE_OUTCOME: Full CatBoost experts, but trained only on sparse official TrackMan-matched R rows and weighted by the older sparse-label selector.
relationship_to_prior_work.V5_COUNTER_RECONSTRUCTED_PITCH_HIERARCHY: Dense reconstructed labels, but only shrinkage control-effect matrices and manual additive corrections; no full outcome experts.
relationship_to_prior_work.V5_ROW_LOCAL_PITCHMIX_SELECTOR: Improved the dense group selector with legal current-season pitchmix state, but connected it only to the same manual correction.
relationship_to_prior_work.new_combination: Dense labels for both selector and full outcome experts, plus row-local pitchmix state in the selector only.

data_contract.dense_group_label: next same-pitcher official asof_pitcher_pitchmix counter increment inside completed history only

selector.features: exact-C matrix plus restored row-local pitcher_id and e53 current-season pitchmix K=20 features

experts.features: exact component C; e53 selector-only pitchmix features removed

candidate.soft_prediction: sum_g P(g | row-local legal selector) * P(success | g, exact-C features)
candidate.blend_formula: F rows remain exact parent; on R, parent + gamma * (dense-MoE - parent)
candidate.selection: maximize minimum full gain across 2020/2021, then minimum R gain, then smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze gamma and recipe before 2022/2023; open 2024 only after both development folds and honest-anchor gates pass.

diagnostic_oracle.purpose: Confirm dense full experts retain goal-scale group headroom; never select or deploy this prediction.
